reuse_policy.small_force_audit: Completed60cell audit is pinned as a prerequisite only; it is not actual-force qualification. Its initial failed480 moving results and all scope limits remain preserved.
reuse_policy.static_zero: Nine20Hz reference grids for3staticBCs×3initialrates may be independently constructed from the exact rest solution plus validated frozen mechanics. They are analytic references, never labelled captured trajectories or actual resets.
reuse_policy.moving_zero: Existing31frame zero trajectories are retained prior evidence only. No upsampling to61frames. Seven fresh20Hz moving-zero cells/templates are included.
reuse_policy.driven: No existing small diagonal/native/static trajectory is reused as an authored-amplitude driven response.

temporal_pass.metric: Full61frame q-coordinate RMSE separately for driven and matching-rate zero response; no error cancellation by zero subtraction.
temporal_pass.criterion: Finest adjacent difference below tolerance and contracts from preceding difference, unless both adjacent differences are below2e-6m. Reevaluate reused zero errors under each family-specific tolerance.
temporal_pass.retain: All actual rates, adjacent errors, signal/tolerance, zero/driven decisions and original failures.

matched_pass.rate: Only the proven accepted temporal candidate rate for each scenario; never assume480/960 after a failure.
matched_pass.accuracy: Driven rtol1e-5/1e-7/1e-9 at floor1e-10; report both adjacent errors, tightest pair below common tolerance. Report effective residual thresholds/floor dominance.
matched_pass.moving_zero_accuracy: At every distinct adopted moving-case rate, zero floors1e-8/1e-10/1e-12; tightest pair below each relevant family tolerance. No duplicate nominal-zero rtol proof.
matched_pass.translation: Undo[0,0,-.25]m and compare complete61frames for every driven scenario plus moving-zero at each adopted rate.
matched_pass.reset: Fresh process/output per driven scenario plus moving-zero at each adopted rate. Compare all saved q/v/rigidposes/commands within1e-12 and report bitwise equality. Analytic static-zero references do not constitute reset evidence.

conditional_refinement.status: Declared proposal only, never automatic execution authorization
conditional_refinement.trigger: Temporal criterion fails while all declared discrete residual/J/constraint guards pass; retain failed initial result. Only prospective parent-authorized exact resolved-rate requests may run.
conditional_refinement.new_runs: Only failing family/rate plus shared moving-zero at that rate when needed; full4/5rate history retained. Matched controls occur only at resulting passing rate, with additional moving-zero matched controls per distinct adopted rate.
conditional_refinement.limits: No amplitude reduction, mesh/material/damping change, dropped frames or relaxed tolerance. Maximum two further rates; failure remains failure and requires new prospective decision. Nonlinear cap/line-search/contact failure is not silently bypassed by another rate.

geometry_contact_guards.scope: Checks concern the declared discrete no-contact model only, not continuous trajectories or real-material validity.
geometry_contact_guards.accepted_endpoints: All accepted fullstates/velocities/residual histories finite; every accepted endpoint tetJ>=0.1; all nonlinear evaluations require J>0 and no stiffness repair.
geometry_contact_guards.constraints: Fixture positions and finite rigid patches/rotations agree within1e-12m or1e-12dimensionless as appropriate at every accepted endpoint.
reported_extrema: Minimum/maximum principal stretches and Green strain
Maximum reference-relative nodal displacement and point-chord speed
Maximum handle rotation/step angle and all residual thresholds/iteration counts
geometry_contact_guards.contact_model: Self-contact and external contact are NOT MODELED. Gravity remains explicitly zero, no floor/externalcolliders or invented handle collision shapes.
geometry_contact_guards.surface_diagnostic: Discrete saved-output nonlocal surface crossings may be reported if a separately tested implementation is available; record evaluated/not_evaluated and exact pair-exclusion policy. Absence at sampled endpoints is not proof of continuous no-contact.
not_required: No invented principal-stretch interval as real-material/admissibility gate
geometry_contact_guards.failure_preservation: Persist first failing endpoint/state, exact force/step clocks, residual/nonlinear history, geometry extrema, last valid state and reason BEFORE cell termination. Preserve failure.json and do not delete/relabel/retry at changed settings.

dataset_admission.qualification_scope: Only these4public static/layout/material/hardware contexts and4exact-family interventions at their original per-case coefficients in the declared discrete no-contact model. It is not a uniform guarantee over all .12-.24N amplitudes, unseen materials/layouts, actualcontact trajectories or native Isaac.
dataset_admission.new_distribution: Before bulk general capture, freeze a prospective TRAIN generation/admission plan with exact per-episode compiler/settings and numeric refinement checks; passed templates do not automatically qualify arbitrary new cases. Do not use reserved response outcomes for threshold/model selection.

public_clock_fidelity.engineering_only: In this119-run study command sampling/quadrature follows solverHz deliberately for temporal refinement. Per-BC/family candidate rates are internal numerical operating points, not a neural public query clock.
public_clock_fidelity.no_latent_label_leakage: Do not expose integration step grids, chosen rate, solver tolerances/refinement outcomes, source IDs or provenance fingerprints as neural public features. A class-specific command_boundary_times_s could reveal the true latentBC.
public_clock_fidelity.production_requirement: Before any learning dataset/admission, prospectively freeze a common known actuator-command clock independent of latentBC/material/layout or inference hypothesis. Solver substeps must refine that fixed externally declared held-command history without changing its force samples, or choose a common conservatively qualified global rate.
public_clock_fidelity.hypothesis_consistency: All candidate physical/BC hypotheses for the same experiment receive identical public known commands/times. Unknown passive force/support programs remain latent; internal teacher/adaptive clocks stay provenance only.
public_clock_fidelity.scope_limit: Passing119variable-clock engineering cells does NOT automatically qualify a BC-specific public command grid or a final neural dataset. Any new common production clock and its actual fixed held-force semantics need prospective qualification before dataset generation.

cpu_policy_proposal.condition: Measure CPUload/RAM/worker progress and unrelatedCOMSOL stability first; preserve all unrelated jobs. No change of numerical settings or omitted cells to increase throughput. Exact driver limits are a separate prelaunch declaration.

resolved_manifest_requirements.separate_stages: Freeze/publish exact runner/auditor/source and resolved stage manifest before executing that stage. This draft is not an execution manifest.
resolved_manifest_requirements.candidate_resolution: Matched templates have no default operational hz. Resolve only to a prospectively allowed passing candidate rate and preserve all failed/coarse evidence. Append exact resolved rate to each matched output ID.
resolved_manifest_requirements.shared_zero: Share a moving-zero control only if physical inputs,rate,tolerances,outputgrid,translation/resetrole are identical. Instantiate extra moving-zero controls at each distinct adopted moving rate, rather than reuse different-rate evidence.
resolved_manifest_requirements.static_analytic: Mark61frame staticzero arrays as analytic rest references with1e-12numerical comparison tolerance and provenance; they are not captured/replayed resets.

physical_model_semantics.teacher: Frozen independent float64 finite-strain log-J Neo-Hookean dynamics with exact rigid patches, authored E/nu/rho and body-only linear drag.
physical_model_semantics.authored_elasticity_damping_field: Original .02 field retained as input lineage, not secretly implemented or claimed equivalent.
physical_model_semantics.force_application: Promoted original force commands at two current handle origins; zero supplied pure torque, zero external nodal force/gravity.
physical_model_semantics.qualification: Exact authored-force command semantics and declared independent discrete model only; no Isaac-engine, continuum or real-material equivalence.

proof_pin_pending_before_launch.required: Completed60cell small-force proof is pinned; all new runner/auditor/resolved manifests still require review, freeze, publication and verification before launch. This draft remains unauthorized.

candidate_proof_contract.rate_guard: A passed flag alone is insufficient: validate complete zero+driven metrics, allowed actual rates, exact source/commands/inputs,61frame clocks, accepted endpoints and failure retention. Pin proof SHA in exact resolved matched manifest.
candidate_proof_contract.initial_false_retained: Any initial failure remains a separate immutable object after conditional refinement; never overwrite its decision with a later passing rate.
candidate_proof_contract.authority: Candidate evidence is produced by an independently reviewed authored-family auditor, not inferred by runner from nominal settings or solver success alone.
